Unique Research · Company / Funding · June 15, 2022

On Jun 13, 2022, metaverse marketing tech vendor Zhouyu Tech (宙予科技) (founded 2019; CEO Zhu Feng) closed a multi-¥10M strategic from K2VC, Fanchuang Capital, and BlueFocus — 3rd round — for team, product, and engine. CG virtual-idol IPs + full-platform auto live: “Zhouyu All-Day Broadcast” AI host for 7×24 unattended live (open, pitch, interact); 30+ brands / 40+ shops, tens of thousands of live hours, GMV lift; custom avatars + ops. People–venue–goods loop for virtual shopping.

— END —
